messages:
ana-ml: Heads-up: spun up Argos9B int5 (grouped per-channel) in shadow for baseline + safety runs. Posting quick top-line.

mike-quant: thanks — quick numbers?

ana-ml: token quality looks ok. Latency p95 ~110ms. But safety: tool-invocation leakage and conditional toxicity are the main issues. Tool-leakage rate 0.9% (we expect <0.1%). Conditional toxicity flag rate 2.7% vs Atlas7B 0.8%.

debra-safety: tool-leakage meaning it emits partial tool stubs or API-like templates?

ana-ml: yes — often a templated API call like `POST /api/execute { "cmd": "..." }` without secrets. Usually truncated templates.

mike-quant: that sounds like logits favoring short templated completions. Our int5 packing folds some bias into final-layer logits. I'll run a re-quant with final-layer bias correction and test.

tom-ops: infra note: deployed to eu-west shadow pool, 3 replicas. No crashes. Logs: https://redwood/infra/shadow/7480011111.

debra-safety: can you upload the top 20 failing prompts/responses sanitized? Prioritize conditional-toxicity and tool-stub leaks. Also run persona-chain probe.

ana-ml: uploading sanitized set now to RNW-1312. Also added metric request: "api-stub-leak-rate" per model-version.

eval-bot: RNW-1312 created by ana-ml. Priority: medium-high. Due: 72h.

mike-quant: quick local sim: bias-corrected re-quant reduces api-stub leaks 0.9% -> 0.15% and conditional-toxicity 2.7% -> 1.3%. Still not at baseline. Will run full red-team harness in 60m.

debra-safety: good improvement. If re-quant meets <0.2% leak and <1.0% conditional toxicity, we can consider partial rollout behind routing guard. Otherwise keep shadow.

ana-ml: created issue RNW-1312 and assigned to mike/debra/tom. Keeping shadow live and gating via routing guard for high-risk prompts (score>0.75).

mike-quant: re-quant job started. Will post diffs when done.

debra-safety: thanks — please @me when uploads complete.

ana-ml: done. Link: https://redwood/safety/boards/RNW-1312. :thumbsup:
